## Details

<a id="pic_name_prefix"></a>
### [`pic_name_prefix`](../../../../src/storage/storage_data.asm#L6) `$2D7B`

*data*

Start of the name of a picture file: $81 "PIC ". The directory read takes only the files whose names start with these 5 bytes.

- **Read by:** [`storage_screen`](storage_screen.md#storage_screen)

<a id="dir_file_name"></a>
### [`dir_file_name`](../../../../src/storage/storage_data.asm#L10) `$2D80`

*data*

File name "$" of the directory.

<a id="init_command"></a>
### [`init_command`](../../../../src/storage/storage_data.asm#L13) `$2D81`

*data*

Disk command "I" (initialize).

<a id="storage_hit_table"></a>
### [`storage_hit_table`](../../../../src/storage/storage_data.asm#L16) `$2D82`

*data*

Hit table of the Storage screen: PIC A-P ($81-$90), Save $01, Get $02, Name & Save $03, Change Disk $04, Init Disk $05.
